info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tetrahed Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Tetrahed Syrup Detail Management API facilitates the addition of detailed information about tetrahed syrup products to the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to enhance their inventory by submitting comprehensive data, including specifications, ingredients, and usage instructions. Typical consumers of this API are developers and product managers within the food and beverage industry looking to streamline product information management. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure their catalogs are accurate, consistent, and aligned with regulatory standards.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for a tetrahed syrup. Provide the necessary information in the request body to successfully add the details.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary details to create or update a tetrahed syrup entry. The payload must comply with the specified JSON schema to ensure that required fields are correctly populated and formatted.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the details are returned.

CreateCatalogTetrahedSyrupDetailRequest.title: Tetrahed Syrup Details Request

tetrahed_syrup_id.description: The unique identifier for the Tetrahed Syrup.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the syrup.

quantity.description: The quantity of Tetrahed Syrup requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of Tetrahed Syrup.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the packaging for the Tetrahed Syrup.

warehouseCodes.description: A list of warehouse codes where the syrup is stored.

items.description: The unique code for each warehouse.
